entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker described as physical in action, devoted in cause and a lone wolf who is never around anyone other than his beasts.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who casts dark spells and owes her soul to demons, including Kothophed.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker with an eye scar and a brother.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker whose story of becoming a planeswalker was filled in by a comic.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: A demon to whom Liliana owes her soul, with creepy, snaggly dialogue in the comics.

relations.note: Liliana owes her soul to Kothophed, one of several demons.
relations.quote: Kothophed, one of the demons to whom Liliana owes her soul
